description: Vindbrukskollen - Vindkraftverk och projekteringsområden is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Länsstyrelserna gemensamt. Vindbrukskollen is an interactive map service for the establishment of wind turbines in Sweden. It can be used throughout the process, from project planning to establishment and dismantling, and aims to facilitate and contribute to a good establishment of wind power in Sweden. Coverage: Länsstyrelserna gemensamt. The portal shows the English title as "Vindbrukskollen - Wind turbines and design areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Länsstyrelserna gemensamt. Its keywords include Vindkraftverk, projektering. The listing shows 3 download or service links in X-SHP, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
